<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic chemical shift range (≈110–160 ppm) are: 147.00 ppm (1 carbon), 133.90 ppm (1 carbon), 128.91 ppm (2 carbons), and 127.68 ppm (2 carbons). Summing these gives 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
